player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Jëfandikukat bi jéem na nangu ab soppi, waaye amul ay ndimbal yu mu soxla.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jigéen {player_id}, Dogu bu njaboot. Kolom {col} doomu nguurte.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} jéem na a def ab joxe-tànneef bu amul ay ndimbal yu soxla.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} def na ab joxe-tànk bu baaxul.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Jëfandikukat {player_id} deful benn laaj bu bees.

offers.reject: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} gàntu na li ñu ko joxe.
offers.accept: Jigéen {acceptor_id} tàmbli nañu ko defar Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Jigéen {player_id} defar nañu ko ci Player {opponent_id}: Joxe: {offered} -> Yegg: {requested}

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat {winner_id} dañ koo jël ci am lu ëpp solo ci li mu war a def.
outcome.draw: Wonees na ci li am solo ngir ñépp.
